practice_questions.question_text: Compare local storage and a cloud-storage service for a small design studio in terms of security responsibility, cost and accessibility. Refer to both approaches throughout.
practice_questions.adaptation_rationale: Cloud infrastructure benefits and limitations are explicit; avoid universal cloud cheaper/backed up assumptions. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
practice_questions.solution: Local storage gives studio direct control of permissions/physical security, whereas cloud shares responsibility with provider and requires vetting configuration. Local has upfront hardware/maintenance cost; cloud commonly recurring subscription/usage cost. Local files can be used without internet when on site; cloud allows authorized remote access but depends on the connection/service.

marking_points.criterion: Paired local direct control versus provider/shared responsibility.
Explains security configuration/trust implication without guarantees.

Paired local offline on site versus cloud remote access.
